description: Lists knowledge sources in a Cognigy.AI knowledge store. Sources are documents (PDFs, web pages, text files) that have been ingested and chunked for RAG retrieval.

knowledgeStoreId.description: The knowledge store ID to list sources from

limit.description: Maximum number of sources to return (default: 25, max: 100)

skip.description: Number of items to skip for pagination

name: list_knowledge_sources
